description: Dumbbell Plume brings the dumbbell chart to Power BI, with no error-bar workaround. Drop a category, then a Start and an End measure (or a legend such as Year): each category gets two points joined by a bar, and the gap is written next to it. Free features, no watermark Gap column: value, %, value and % or percentage points, with ▲ ▼ symbols; as a column, after the last point or above the bar. Direction: color by series or by direction (favorable / unfavorable), "a decrease is favorable" for costs or lead times. Sort and focus: by last point, gap, absolute gap, %, name; Top N; horizontal or vertical; smooth scrolling for thousands of rows. Labels: end labels, series names on the first row. Power BI: tooltips, cross-filtering, highlighting, right-click menu, keyboard, high contrast, dynamic formats, English and French; 30,000 rows and more with fetchMoreData. Premium features ★ Play axis: drop a year or a date and press play: dumbbells slide to their new values and their new rank (animated transitions, speed, loop, keyboard). Analytics: average line per series, stability threshold (● stable), gap as a ratio, logarithmic scale. More than two points per category (dot plot), arrows and gradient bars from the first to the last point.
